# Anchors cited from outside this repository.
#
# Each line is a published-site path and the heading anchor a downstream repo
# links to. `mkdocs build --strict` validates links *within* this handbook, so
# it cannot see an inbound link at all: renaming a heading here breaks a
# citation over there and nothing in either repository notices. This list is
# what makes that visible, and `ci.yml` asserts every entry still resolves in
# the built site on each pull request.
#
# Every heading listed here carries an explicit `{ #slug }` in its source, so
# the anchor survives a rewording of the heading text. The contract is that
# the anchor does not change unless the citing repository changes in the same
# breath — see the "Linking to this handbook from another repository" section
# of README.md.
#
# To retire an entry, remove the citation downstream first, then this line.
# To add one, give the heading an explicit anchor and add it here.
#
# Format: <site path>#<anchor>   — blank lines and `#` comments are ignored.

# --- cited from deltadewa/docs/part-x-coverage.md ---
part-6/hedge-efficiency-ratio/#her-metric
part-6/hedge-efficiency-ratio/#mathematical-definition-of-the-ratio
part-10/introduction/#example-of-a-full-dashboard
part-10/tier-4-tactical-optional-trading-metrics/#13-delta-drift
part-7/rolling-rules/#rule-1-time-based-roll
part-7/rolling-rules/#rule-2-market-rally-rebalance-trigger
